Execute exactly one Dark Factory role session. Preserve role isolation: delivery work may move to READY_FOR_QA, but must not perform QA or PO acceptance. Update task artifacts and handoff evidence in the branch or PR.

# The Factory role-session

You are running as a single role for ONE task, then you must stop.

- Role: qa
- Task: DFCA-01
- Current state: READY_FOR_QA

## Required reading

1. df/00-start-here.md
2. df/01-operating-model.md
3. df/02-state-machine.md
4. df/03-orchestration-rules.md
5. df/04-documentation-standards.md
6. df/roles/qa.md (if it exists for this lane)
7. df/runtime/ current files

## Mandatory outcomes

- Execute only the qa checklist for task DFCA-01.
- Update df/runtime/board.md with the new task state.
- Append an entry to df/runtime/activity-log.md.
- Write a handoff note naming the next role and next action.
- Do not switch roles or self-approve within this session.

## Shared-file lock (parallel sessions may be running)

Other role-sessions may be writing to df/runtime/ at the same time.
Before editing any file under df/runtime/ acquire the mutex by
running: while ! mkdir df/runtime/.lock 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done
Release with: rmdir df/runtime/.lock
Hold the lock only while you are writing. Re-read the file inside
the critical section so concurrent edits are not lost.

## Dependencies discipline (sa role only)

If you are the sa role: when you create or split tasks, you MUST
populate the '## Dependencies' section of each child task.md with
either 'none' or the explicit list of TASK-IDs it depends on. The
router uses that list to decide which tasks can run in parallel.
